questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Course registration was horrible. It made me regret my choice of university

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Stressful, no answers to emails, courses were offered to local students first. I chose Sciences Po to take classes in Environmental Politics but these were not available at all.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: None. A teacher helped me get a place in her course in the end

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I only registered for two classes I wanted. It was very disappointing

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don't choose the university because of the classes because they will not be offered to exchange students

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The academic program was quite fine but, again, I was not allowed to participate in the classes I was interested in. 2 out of 5 of the classes were not academic at all.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Some were ok. Less academic than in Copenhagen

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: More "inclusive". Students were more engaged

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Discrimination and Inequality
Human Rights in International Relations
Rethinking Partnerships for Greater Developmental Impact
Desalination of Water
Gender Economics

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Discrimination and Inequality
Human Rights in International Relations

I would also recommend Desalination of Water although it is highly specialized for people with a background in environmental studies

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I liked that French people are not scared to speak their mind or have disputes in public. They also have a good sense of humor.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Don't expect courses to be available
2. Courses are less academic
3. It is nice that classes only have 22 students
